written.headline: OpenAI raises security bug bounty rewards and adds new researcher bonuses
written.summary: OpenAI announced increased bug bounty payouts and introduced report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

written.headline: OpenAI teams with Cathedral Systems for next internal security sprint
written.summary: OpenAI announced it is partnering with Cathedral Systems to run its next internal security sprint, using AI to test and harden its defenses. The effort follows recent patches to vulnerabilities in ChatGPT’s HTML preview sandbox.
